title: I ordered and paid for a NEW ice tea maker!!
text:
I ordered and paid for a NEW ice tea maker!!. Been a long time since I have spoiled my self with an automatic tea maker! I have a one cup coffee maker so the coffee pot does not do double duty any longer. And its a pain to boil and steep on the stove so my Home tea drinking has died off for a while and the soda went up. That needed to change. So Found this one and was very happy with the reviews it had so ordered a NEW one!
Now for the good part... It was sent UPS.. then transferred to the post office for delivery. Once it is in the Post Office hands UPS will not track nor talk to you about your shipment by the way. When the tracker said delivered to the Local Post office I started thinking that I was needing to go down there to pick it up! Would be nice for someone to give the customer a heads up instead of confusing us! Any way enough of the delivery. So I opened the smiling Amazon box and what did I find? A re-taped box...hmmm? Sometimes that happens I've been in retail for a long wile and sometimes you open packages to copy manuals or customer service. OK... moving on... The Pitcher is not wrapped nor in a package? The strainer is in plastic but the tape is open? and the unit it's self... none of the usual shipping peel and stick shipping plastic on the machine what so ever just the two pieces of sryrofoam and the Brewer in between! I don't believe this is a new unit!? ANYONE else get there Ice Tea maker in the box like I described?

product_metadata.title: Mr. Coffee 2-in-1 Iced Tea Brewing System with Glass Pitcher, 2.5 quarts
features: 2-in-1 Brewing for fresh iced tea with any flavor tea bags or tea leaves
Fast Brewing Cycle makes up to 2.5 quarts fast and fresh in just minutes
Lift & Clean Filter -Basket with Permanent Filter pulls out and wash off easily
Brew Strength Selector switches up the flavor to strong if you like it bolder tasting
Auto Shut Off powers off tea maker as soon as it's done brewing
Power ON Indicator: lights up to show it's on
Water Reservoir with Window, No overflows! See exact water level as you fill
Water Filtration Ready: Removes up to 97% of chlorine* for better tasting iced tea
* As a result of the Mr. Coffee water filter and brewing process
description: Gourmet-style iced tea has never been easier thanks to the Mr. Coffee 2-in-1 Iced Tea Brewing System. This automatic iced tea maker brews tea bags or tea leaves to your desired strength, thanks to its adjustable Brew Strength Selector. Enjoy creating your own custom-flavored iced tea drinks or follow one of the 20 Mr. Coffee recipes included. Skip the expensive coffeehouse concoctions and enjoy fresh iced tea at home.
